dedupe_keys.name: real time ambulance two phase assignment routing gams code and dataset

description: Saba Azarnoush and Arash Nemati publish GAMS code and datasets for three real-time ambulance assignment-routing scenarios. Zenodo lists a RAR archive containing the code and scenario data, released in May 2026. This makes the resource a concrete input for testing assignment and routing decisions in emergency-service models. The repository metadata does not identify a city, observation period, network size or time-step resolution, and it does not give the detailed objective functions. These remain unknown until the documentation inside the archive can be inspected. The deposit is open under CC BY 4.0 and free to obtain; this licence does not establish the cost of a GAMS installation or solver. The code was not run. Its three scenarios are narrower than a general ambulance simulator, but that alone does not remove their reuse value. No direct link to another catalogue record is documented.
